depends_on.description: Every occurrence fingerprint embeds a complete a11y/pattern/v1 fingerprint. An occurrence fingerprint is not independently meaningful without its pattern fingerprint.

profile.description: Must equal the profile name exactly. Included in the canonicalized input so that a pattern and an occurrence fingerprint computed from otherwise-identical JSON never collide across profiles.

pattern_fingerprint.description: The complete, authoritative pattern fingerprint this occurrence belongs to. Must contain the full 64-character digest, never a shortened display ID.

profile.description: The pattern profile the embedded fingerprint was computed under, e.g. "a11y/pattern/v1".

algorithm.description: The hash algorithm used to compute the embedded pattern fingerprint, e.g. "sha-256".

value.description: The full authoritative pattern fingerprint. A shortened display ID (e.g. A11Y-PAT-EA3B846C4F12) must never be used here.

location.description: The normalized location of this occurrence.

scope.description: The kind of location boundary this occurrence was observed at.

normalization_profile.description: Identifies the immutable normalization contract applied to location.key, e.g. "a11y/route/v1".

key.description: The normalized resource, route pattern, or component-state key. A generalized route such as "/node/[nid]" may represent several observed resources.

test_profile.description: Use JSON null by default. A project may use a named test profile when it intentionally treats test configurations (e.g. a defined browser/viewport/theme combination) as separate occurrences. A test profile must come from explicit project configuration; it must not be inferred from viewport width or described as a physical device without evidence.
